review.scope: prepared six-cell kit at calibrated runtime scale; finished opening scene remains unapproved
strengths: The corrected first cell is a broad continuous masonry wall without a doorway or implied walkable opening.
The six silhouettes share one elevated camera, weathered material family, restrained ember lighting, and compact grounded contacts.
Both lanterns are matching but non-identical designs at the same authored scale, and the deterministic runtime preview preserves equal logical height.
warnings: The generated raw backdrop is tolerant near-magenta rather than literal #ff00ff and therefore fails the strict raw contract.
Several raw objects miss the requested 62-pixel equal-cell inset; deterministic preparation must prove that this is fully remediated before any cell can be considered ingress-safe.

The first independent review passed the source kit at 7.5/10 for a controlled trial but found the initial declared runtime sizes miniature beside the 118px player. The second independent review passed all six calibrated silhouettes against the exact production-floor contact sheet.
The wall must be a single centered feature with retained tile-backed outer facades; it must never be stretched or visibly repeated.
Runtime collision must follow the visible composite masses rather than the audit's narrow alpha-support proxy.
review.decision: Authorize promotion of the deterministic prepared bytes only for a controlled runtime integration trial at wall 172px, forge 195px, identical lanterns 118px, barricade 88px, and bench 103px. Finished-scene acceptance still requires fresh portrait and landscape gameplay review with actors, collision, sprite light pools, and HUD.
